attempts.sql: SELECT ca.class_symbol_id, MIN(ca.depth) AS depth FROM code.class_ancestry ca WHERE ca.ancestor_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/server/models.py::ApiModel' AND ca.depth >= 2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.class_bases cb WHERE cb.class_symbol_id = ca.class_symbol_id AND (cb.base_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/server/models.py::ApiModel' OR cb.base_name LIKE '%ApiModel%' OR cb.base_name LIKE '%_Payload%')) GROUP BY ca.class_symbol_id ORDER BY depth, class_symbol_id

request:
Which classes inherit from ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/models.py) only indirectly, i.e. through at least one intermediate class of this repository, and do not name ApiModel directly in their class statement? An import alias of ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/responses.py imports it as _Payload) counts as naming ApiModel directly, and a subscripted base such as ListResponse[T] counts as its class. For each, give the class symbol ID and the length of the shortest inheritance chain to ApiModel (2 when the parent class directly subclasses ApiModel).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), depth (integer).
explanation: Finds all classes that transitively inherit from ApiModel in auto_ontology/server/models.py with a shortest chain of at least 2 steps, then excludes any class whose own class statement names ApiModel directly (including the _Payload alias or a subscripted form). Returns each remaining class symbol ID with its minimum inheritance depth.
sql: SELECT ca.class_symbol_id, MIN(ca.depth) AS depth FROM code.class_ancestry ca WHERE ca.ancestor_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/server/models.py::ApiModel' AND ca.depth >= 2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.class_bases cb WHERE cb.class_symbol_id = ca.class_symbol_id AND (cb.base_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/server/models.py::ApiModel' OR cb.base_name LIKE '%ApiModel%' OR cb.base_name LIKE '%_Payload%')) GROUP BY ca.class_symbol_id ORDER BY depth, class_symbol_id
